content: {"episode_id":"ep-05029","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication. The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture and correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. Authorization is missing, and this appeal requests review of the clinical indication without asserting that prior authorization was obtained."}
